en: Dad drank again last night
and went wild
If Dad would just stop drinking,
he'd be a good man...
I'm worn out. I'm so tired.
Every single day.
Why are you so tired?
I work at the glass factory.
They work me like a dog.
Another factory worker died today.
If I keep working there,
I think I'll get sick too.
I wonder if I'll get paid more
when I grow up.
I'm just a kid, so no matter how
hard I work, I hardly earn a thing.
Is that you, Dad?
Oh, it's not Dad.
Of course, Dad wouldn't
be coming home at this hour.
Where did your father go?
He's probably drinking at Sans Souci.
I have to do my factory work at home too,
so I'll be going...
I'm busy.
Dad is at Sans Souci,
drinking.
so...
Dad drank again last night
and went wild...
Both grown-ups and kids work here.
Are you going to work here too?
It's dark and dusty in here,
I feel like I'll get sick.
Some people really do get sick.
Every day someone's taken to the hospital.
Hey, are you going to work here too?
Sometimes people are carried straight to the grave.
Work I can't finish at the factory today,
I do at home.
As long as it's just polishing pearls,
I can do it at home too.
I'm a polisher's helper.
I polish glass pearls.
I'm still small, so this is the only
work they'll let me do.
It's easy, but it's hard work.
I really want to go to school too,
but I have to earn money.
It's awful. Last night I polished
pearls till midnight, and my drunk Dad
broke every single one.
The factory foreman yelled at me...
And now I won't get paid at all.
Dad apologized to me this morning.
He said he was sorry he broke the pearls.
He said he wouldn't go wild anymore,
but I bet he forgets when he's drunk.
Even a Dad like that is still
my Dad.
he'd be a good man
